the kinetic theory of weakly ionized plasmas in a magnetic field was developed by using the Bogolybubov method, and the equations derived were used to study the relaxation of the ionic atmosphere and frequency dispersion of the complex dielectrics in the presence of an external magnetic field.

The main takeaway from our work is that
in the absence of external magnetic fields the relaxation of the electron and ion atmospheres is described by a single exponential function.
the theory of weakly ionized plasmas in magnetic fields is a generalization of the theory of weak electrolytes.
